[TODO:tr] John stands in the river.
His eyes find yours.

demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] You did not come to be honored.

wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] The Father waits for this moment.
Go to John.

"I should be baptized by You."

choices.text: [TODO:tr] "Let it be so to fulfill all."

choices.text: [TODO:tr] "Let it be so to fulfill all."
